translationRepairs: On jiawu court envoys were commissioned to ennoble the late Princess Meng of Fortune and Celebration as Long Princess Yongshun of Jin; Grand Minister of Rites Cui Jujian was sent to the Western Circuit to perform the investiture.

On jiawu court envoys were commissioned to ennoble the late Long Princess of Fortune and Celebration, Lady Meng, as Long Princess Yongshun of Jin; the Grand Minister of Rites Cui Jujian was sent to the Western Circuit to perform the investiture.
福慶長公主 is the late princess's prior title, while 孟氏 identifies her as Lady Meng; the revision restores that distinction.
On dingsi Ma Xizhen, commissioner of Qianzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, and Palace Attendant, was made commissioner of Hongzhou;
On dingsi Ma Xizhen, commissioner of Qianzhou, Acting Grand Commandant, and Palace Attendant, was made commissioner of Hongzhou;
太尉 is Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor; 'Grand Commandant' is also the terminology already used elsewhere in this edition.
On gengyin Li Yancong, campaign marshal of Fengxiang, was made defense commissioner of Yazhou.
On gengyin Li Yancong, campaign marshal of Fengxiang, was made defense commissioner of Yanzhou.
鹽州 is Yanzhou, not Yazhou; an explanatory parenthesis is unnecessary in the running annal.
On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Shou, Military Affairs Commissioners, were additionally made Palace Attendants while retaining their posts.
On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou, Military Affairs Commissioners, were additionally made Palace Attendants while retaining their posts.
The Chinese explicitly gives 趙延壽; the existing Zhao Shou drops the middle character of the attested personal name.
